translation_en: Today, 4 March 2026, the app froze and I could not place a single buy or sell order all afternoon, on a day the market was red from start to finish. When prices recovered near the close, it would not let me buy to lower my average cost. It would not let me withdraw my money either.
I deposited money and the bank said the transfer was successful, but the app showed nothing credited. The money still has not reached my account.
I cannot transfer money out to my bank. The OTP confirmation never arrives; the timer counts down again and again and I still cannot withdraw.
A finance app that updates four or five times a week. Every update brings new bugs, and afterwards it wipes my login details and settings.
I never pressed renew, but it renewed automatically, so I lost money.
The advance fee is quoted at 13.5 per cent a year, but in practice it is 27 per cent a year. Hidden fees, wrong fees.
